items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That was at Rudy Van Gelder’s. ... That was the last studio of his I was in.

ctx.x: Here we are, Very Cool. This is with you, Don Ferrara, Sal Mosca, Peter Ind, and Shadow Wilson from May of nineteen fifty seven.
Oh yeah. That was at Rudy Van Gelder’s.
It doesn’t say. I’ll take your word for it, although at the time, Rudy was still recording out of his parent’s living room in Hackensack.
